parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit has two files that together form a small, cohesive NestJS dashboard feature. DashboardController exposes three read-only stats endpoints, and each one simply delegates to DashboardService. DashboardModule wires that controller and service together and imports AuthModule so the guards can run. Neither file duplicates a rule or invariant: guards are applied once at the class level, and there is no business logic in the controller. Neither file bypasses the module's own abstractions: the controller calls only the injected DashboardService, with no direct data or ORM access, and returns the module's own interface types.
